name: dark
note: AoE2 wiki "Random map", Starting Age: a start in an age researches the technologies of all earlier ages (#2265)

name: post-imperial
note: AoE2 wiki "Post-Imperial Age": all technologies, not Spies/Treason, Flemish Revolution, First Crusade (not in the game program)

name: regicide
note: AoE2 wiki "Regicide (game mode)": each player starts with a King, a player whose Kings all died is defeated (#2347)

name: empire-wars
note: AoE2 wiki "Empire Wars" (DE): Feudal Age, a mill, 3 lumber camps, a mining camp, 6 houses, 5 farms, a barracks and 27 villagers: 4 on gold, 12 on wood, 6 on food (2 on farms, 4 on berry bushes) and the rest idle at the sheep under the town center, here on food too; the Scout of the scenario stays (#2408)

name: sudden-death
note: AoE2 wiki "Sudden Death": each player can have only one town center, a player who loses it is defeated (#2407)

name: battle-royale
note: AoE2 wiki "Battle Royale": the Corruption takes the map from its border to its center (battle_royale.py, #2439)

name: defend-the-wonder
note: AoE2 wiki "Defend the Wonder": player 1 defends a Wonder for 250 years, the others attack it; all start in the Post-Imperial Age; 900 of each resource for the defender, 600 for its team mates, 1200 food, 900 wood, 1200 gold and 600 stone for the attackers; not yet: the stone walls around each base and the Castle of each attacker (#2441)
